faqs.q: What are Oteco packing units for Hydril GK, GKM and MSP annular BOPs?
faqs.a: Oteco packing units are replacement annular packing elements for Hydril GK, GKM and MSP blowout preventers, moulded and mixed in Oteco's own rubber plant in Houston. Each unit is functionally tested before it ships. The range runs from 7-1/16" to 21-1/4" bore in 24 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read an Oteco Hydril packing unit part number such as 211351 or 211352?
faqs.a: The last digit of the Oteco packing unit number gives the compound: 1 is natural rubber, 2 is nitrile and 3 is neoprene, so 211351, 211352 and 211353 are the three compounds for the 13-5/8" 5,000 psi preventer. The brochure lists the compounds side by side as NR / NBR / CR. Send us the number and we confirm it against your BOP nameplate.

faqs.q: Which Hydril annular BOPs do Oteco 210731 to 212123 packing units fit?
faqs.a: They are made to fit Hydril GK, GKM and MSP annular preventers; this is a fit statement, not an equivalence claim. The size table names the bore, pressure and head type for each part number, covering screw-head, latch-head and helicopter-lift-head preventers. Hydril is a trademark of its owner and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with that maker.

faqs.q: What bore and pressure sizes do Oteco Hydril packing units cover?
faqs.a: Oteco lists Hydril packing units for 7-1/16" at 3,000 and 5,000 psi, 9" at 3,000 psi, 11" and 13-5/8" at 3,000 and 5,000 psi, and 21-1/4" at 2,000 psi. Each size is offered in natural rubber, nitrile and neoprene. Match the bore, working pressure and head type on the BOP nameplate before ordering.

faqs.q: Which Oteco packing unit do I order for a 13-5/8" Hydril GK annular BOP?
faqs.a: For a 13-5/8" preventer Oteco lists 211331, 211332 and 211333 at 3,000 psi and 211351, 211352 and 211353 at 5,000 psi, in natural rubber, nitrile and neoprene. Pick the pressure and head type from the nameplate, then the compound for your mud. The size table gives the head types each unit fits.

faqs.q: What working pressures are Oteco Hydril annular packing units listed for?
faqs.a: Oteco lists these units from 2,000 psi, for the 21-1/4" bore, up to 5,000 psi for the 7-1/16", 11" and 13-5/8" sizes. Use the working pressure stamped on the preventer, not just the bore, because several bores come in two pressure classes with different part numbers. The 9" size is listed at 3,000 psi.

faqs.q: Which compound should I choose for Oteco Hydril packing units: NR, NBR or neoprene?
faqs.a: Oteco recommends natural rubber (NR) for water-based mud, where it gives the best low-temperature flexibility and the longest life when oil content is low. Nitrile (NBR) suits oil-based and synthetic-based mud and hydrocarbons. Neoprene (CR) suits mixed and low-aniline-point fluids where natural rubber swells.

faqs.q: Which seals should I order with Oteco Hydril annular packing units?
faqs.a: Order the matching seal kit when you change the packing unit; for example 220750 goes with the 7-1/16" 5,000 psi unit and 221350 with the 13-5/8" 5,000 psi unit. Head gaskets and U-seals are also sold singly. See [Oteco seal kits for Hydril annular BOPs](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-seal-kits) for every part number.

faqs.q: Does an Oteco Hydril packing unit need testing after it is fitted?
faqs.a: Oteco functionally tests every packing unit before it leaves its Houston plant, but the preventer itself should still be function and pressure tested on the rig after the change, following your well-control procedure. Bring the BOP nameplate details and the old element when you order, so we confirm the part and compound.

faqs.q: When do rigs replace the packing unit in a Hydril GK or MSP annular BOP?
faqs.a: The packing unit is the wearing part of an annular preventer, replaced when the rubber is worn, cut or swollen from the wrong mud type, and as part of a BOP recertification. It sits in the [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts) range with seals and ram packers. For the choice between annular and ram preventers see the guide on [ram vs annular BOPs](/blog/ram-vs-annular-bop).

faqs.q: Where are Oteco annular BOP packing units made?
faqs.a: Oteco annular packing units are made in Houston, Texas, USA, in the maker's own rubber plant, where it formulates and mixes the compounds. The country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East and supplies the maker's documentation and part numbers.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco Hydril annular BOP packing units and how do I get a quote?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco Hydril annular BOP packing units in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. To quote, send the Oteco part number, or the BOP type, bore, working pressure, head type and compound. [request a quote](/quote) or [contact us](/contact) and we confirm the part and delivery.

faqs.q: What are Oteco packing units for Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K annular BOPs?
faqs.a: They are replacement annular packing units, moulded and tested by Oteco in Houston, for Shaffer spherical BOPs in 11" and 13-5/8" 5,000 psi and Regan Type K BOPs in 8-5/8" and 10-3/4" 3,000 psi. The listing has 6 part numbers.

faqs.q: What do the Oteco part numbers 231151, 231351 and 242508 mean for Shaffer and Regan BOPs?
faqs.a: The 2311 and 2313 numbers are Shaffer spherical units for the 11" and 13-5/8" bore, and the last digit gives the compound: 1 for natural rubber and 2 for nitrile, so 231151 is natural rubber and 231152 is nitrile. The Regan Type K units 242508 and 242510 are nitrile for the 8-5/8" and 10-3/4" bore.

faqs.q: Which Shaffer and Regan annular BOPs do Oteco packing units fit?
faqs.a: They are made to fit Shaffer spherical annular preventers and Regan Type K annular preventers; this is a fit statement, not an equivalence claim. Shaffer, Regan, Hydril and Grant are trademarks of their owners, and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with those makers. Confirm the model on your BOP nameplate before ordering.

faqs.q: What sizes of Oteco Shaffer spherical packing unit are listed?
faqs.a: Oteco lists Shaffer spherical packing units for 11" and 13-5/8" bore preventers, both at 5,000 psi. For the 11" unit the numbers are 231151 in natural rubber and 231152 in nitrile; for the 13-5/8" unit they are 231351 and 231352. No neoprene unit is listed for the Shaffer spherical sizes.

faqs.q: Which Oteco packing unit fits a Regan Type K annular BOP, 8-5/8" or 10-3/4"?
faqs.a: Oteco lists 242508 for the 8-5/8" Regan Type K and 242510 for the 10-3/4" Regan Type K, both 3,000 psi and both in nitrile. Choose by the bore stamped on the preventer. If your Regan model is not one of these two sizes, send the nameplate details and we check with Oteco.

faqs.q: What working pressures do Oteco Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K packing units cover?
faqs.a: The Shaffer spherical units are listed for 5,000 psi preventers in 11" and 13-5/8" bores, and the Regan Type K units for 3,000 psi preventers in 8-5/8" and 10-3/4" bores. Match the pressure rating on the BOP nameplate with the size table before ordering.

faqs.q: Which compound do Oteco Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K packing units come in?
faqs.a: The Shaffer spherical units come in natural rubber (NR) and nitrile (NBR); natural rubber suits water-based fluids and nitrile suits oil-based fluids. The Regan Type K element is moulded in nitrile for oil-based and water-based drilling fluids, and it contracts around any part of the drill string when pressure is applied.

faqs.q: Do Oteco Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K packing units have matching seal kits?
faqs.a: The seal kits and U-seals in the Oteco range are listed for Hydril GK and MSP preventers; the size table lists no seal kit for the Shaffer or Regan units. Send the BOP model and size and we confirm what is available. For Hydril kits see [Oteco seal kits for Hydril annular BOPs](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-seal-kits).

faqs.q: How should an Oteco Regan Type K packing element be matched to the drill string?
faqs.a: The Type K element contracts around any part of the drill string when pressure is applied, so it is sized to the preventer bore, 8-5/8" or 10-3/4", not to the pipe. Fit the nitrile unit that matches the bore on the nameplate and test the preventer on the rig after the change.

faqs.q: When would a rig order Oteco Shaffer spherical or Regan Type K annular packing units?
faqs.a: Order a packing unit when the annular element is worn, cut or swollen, or as part of a BOP recertification. Oteco's range sits in [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts). For the Hydril range see [Oteco Hydril annular packing units](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-packing-units); those are for Hydril GK, GKM and MSP preventers.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K annular BOP packing units?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco Shaffer spherical and Regan Type K annular BOP packing units in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the Oteco part number, or the BOP make, type, bore and pressure, then [request a quote](/quote) and we confirm the part and delivery.

faqs.q: Who makes Oteco annular packing units and where?
faqs.a: Oteco Inc. makes them in Houston, Texas, USA, in its own rubber plant, where it formulates and mixes the compounds, and tests each unit before it ships. The country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is the authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East; [contact us](/contact) for the maker's documentation.

faqs.q: What are Oteco seal kits and seals for Hydril GK and MSP annular BOPs?
faqs.a: They are nitrile (NBR) seal kit sets, head gaskets and upper, middle, lower and inner U-seals, moulded by Oteco for Hydril GK and MSP annular preventers from 7-1/16" to 21-1/4". The listing has 38 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read Oteco seal kit numbers such as 220750 or 221350?
faqs.a: The numbers ending in 0 are the complete seal kit set for a given preventer: 220730 is 7-1/16" 3,000 psi, 220750 is 7-1/16" 5,000 psi and 221350 is 13-5/8" 5,000 psi. The next numbers in each group are the head gasket and the individual U-seals, for example 220751 head gasket and 220752 upper U-seal.

faqs.q: Which Hydril annular BOPs are the Oteco seal kits made for?
faqs.a: They are made for Hydril GK and MSP annular preventers; this is a fit statement, not an equivalence claim. The Fits column of the size table names the bore, pressure and head type for each seal, and several seals fit more than one preventer size. Hydril is a trademark of its owner and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with that maker.

faqs.q: Which Oteco seal kit fits a 11" 5,000 psi Hydril annular BOP?
faqs.a: Oteco lists seal kit 221150 for the 11" 5,000 psi Hydril GK screw-head preventer, with head gasket 221151 and U-seals 221152, 221153 and 221154 listed singly. Some of these also fit other sizes, so read the Fits column. Match the bore, pressure and head type on the nameplate.

faqs.q: Is there an Oteco seal kit for the latch-head 13-5/8" 5,000 psi Hydril GK?
faqs.a: Yes, the Oteco size table lists a latch-head seal kit for the 13-5/8" 5,000 psi Hydril GK preventer, and the U-seals 221352 and 221353 are listed for screw or latch head of that size. Check the Fits column for each part, and send the nameplate details so we confirm the right number.

faqs.q: What pressure classes do Oteco Hydril annular seal kits cover?
faqs.a: The kits are listed for Hydril annular preventers from 2,000 psi, the 21-1/4" MSP, up to 5,000 psi, the 7-1/16", 11" and 13-5/8" sizes. Bores such as 7-1/16" and 13-5/8" have separate kits at 3,000 and 5,000 psi, so order by pressure as well as bore.

faqs.q: What material are the Oteco Hydril annular seal kits made from?
faqs.a: Every seal in the Oteco kits is moulded in nitrile (NBR). Nitrile suits oil-based and synthetic-based mud and hydrocarbons. If your mud system or temperature range is unusual, send the details and we confirm suitability with Oteco before you order.

faqs.q: Should I order an Oteco seal kit with each Hydril packing unit?
faqs.a: Yes, Oteco advises ordering the seal kit with each packing unit change. For example the 13-5/8" 5,000 psi packing units 211351, 211352 and 211353 pair with seal kit 221350. See [Oteco packing units for Hydril annular BOPs](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-packing-units) for the matching units.

faqs.q: What does an Oteco Hydril annular seal kit contain?
faqs.a: A kit contains the head gasket and the upper, middle and lower U-seals, with an inner U-seal on some sizes, all in nitrile. The head gasket and U-seals are also listed singly, so you can replace one worn seal without buying the full kit.

faqs.q: When is an Oteco seal kit used on a Hydril annular BOP?
faqs.a: Rigs use a seal kit when the annular preventer is stripped for a packing unit change or recertification. The kit sits with other consumables in [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts). Read [ram vs annular BOPs](/blog/ram-vs-annular-bop) for how annular preventers differ from ram preventers.

faqs.q: Where are Oteco annular BOP seal kits made and what is their origin?
faqs.a: Oteco seals are moulded by Oteco Inc. in Houston, Texas, USA, and the country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East. [contact us](/contact) for the maker's documentation and part numbers.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco seal kits for Hydril annular BOPs?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco seal kits and seals for Hydril annular BOPs in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quote send the Oteco part number, or the Hydril type, bore, working pressure and head type. [request a quote](/quote) to start.

faqs.q: What are Oteco stripper rubbers for Shaffer Type 50, 74, 79 and 51 rotating heads?
faqs.a: They are combination rotating BOP and stripper rubbers that seal around the drill pipe while it rotates and strips, for Shaffer Type 50, 74, 79 and 51 rotating heads, 2-3/8" to 6-5/8" drill pipe. Oteco has moulded them in Houston since 1968. The listing has 35 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read Oteco stripper rubber codes such as SHR-9013 and SHR-9,013B-X?
faqs.a: SHR is the Shaffer rotating-head stripper code and the number is a model code tied to a pipe range, for example SHR-9013 for 4-1/2" to 5-1/2" pipe. X and B suffixes are construction variants of the base stripper. Each code has a natural rubber part number and a nitrile one: SHR-9013 is 241104 in NR and 241404 in NBR.

faqs.q: Which Shaffer rotating heads do these Oteco stripper rubbers fit?
faqs.a: They are made to fit Shaffer Type 50, 74 and 79 rotating heads and the Type 51 head; this is a fit statement, not an equivalence claim. Shaffer is a trademark of its owner and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with that maker. Confirm the head type and pipe size before ordering.

faqs.q: Which Oteco stripper rubber fits a Shaffer Type 50 head on 4-1/2" to 5-1/2" drill pipe?
faqs.a: SHR-9013 is listed for 4-1/2" to 5-1/2" drill pipe on Shaffer 50, 74 and 79 heads and expands to pass an 8" OD; the natural rubber part number is 241104 and the nitrile one is 241404. A B variant, SHR-9,013B, is listed as 241106 and 241406.

faqs.q: What drill pipe sizes do Oteco Shaffer stripper rubbers cover?
faqs.a: On the Type 50, 74 and 79 heads they cover 2-3/8" to 6-5/8" drill pipe in five base sizes, SHR-469, SHR-708, SHR-709, SHR-9013 and SHR-11113. The Type 51 head takes SHR-15506 for 2-3/8" to 2-7/8" pipe, SHR-15600 for 2-7/8" and SHR-15700 for 3-1/2".

faqs.q: How large a tool joint will an Oteco Shaffer stripper rubber pass?
faqs.a: Each rubber stretches to pass tool joints up to the listed OD: 6-1/2" for SHR-469 and SHR-708, 8" for SHR-709, SHR-9013 and SHR-11113, and 5" for the Type 51 rubbers SHR-15506, SHR-15600 and SHR-15700. The size table gives the pass-through OD for every part number.

faqs.q: Should I choose natural rubber or nitrile Oteco stripper rubbers for a Shaffer head?
faqs.a: Natural rubber (NR) suits water-based drilling fluids and nitrile (NBR) suits oil-based drilling fluids. Every Shaffer stripper size is listed in both compounds, for example SHR-708 as 241102 in NR and 241402 in NBR. A Type 50 lip seal in fabric-reinforced neoprene is also available.

faqs.q: What other stripper rubbers does Oteco make besides Shaffer?
faqs.a: Oteco also makes stripper rubbers for Grant rotating heads, see [Oteco Grant rotating head stripper rubbers](/p/oteco-grant-rotating-head-stripper-rubbers), and tubing stripper rubbers for several other stripper heads, including Beaumont Iron Works PX-70 and PX-107 and Hydril RS. Tell us the head and the tubing size.

faqs.q: How do I pick the right Oteco stripper rubber for my Shaffer rotating head?
faqs.a: Pick by head type, drill pipe size and compound. The pipe size sets the code, for example SHR-11113 for 5-1/2" to 6-5/8" pipe, and the drilling fluid sets NR or NBR. Send the head type and pipe size with the old rubber's markings and we confirm the Oteco number.

faqs.q: When do rigs replace the stripper rubber in a Shaffer rotating head?
faqs.a: The stripper rubber is a wearing part that is worn by rotation and by tool joints passing through, so it is replaced when it no longer seals around the pipe. It belongs with other consumables in [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts). For packing units on annular preventers see [Oteco Hydril annular packing units](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-packing-units).

faqs.q: Where are Oteco rotating head stripper rubbers made?
faqs.a: Oteco Inc. moulds them in Houston, Texas, USA, and has done so since 1968. The country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East; [contact us](/contact) for documentation.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco stripper rubbers for Shaffer rotating heads?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco stripper rubbers for Shaffer rotating heads in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quote send the SHR code or Oteco part number, or the head type, drill pipe size and compound. [request a quote](/quote) to start.

faqs.q: What are Oteco stripper rubbers for Grant 7068 and 8068 rotating heads?
faqs.a: They are replacement stripper rubbers for Grant Model 7068 and 8068 rotating heads, moulded by Oteco in Houston and sized to the drill pipe, 2-3/8" to 5-1/2". The listing has 15 part numbers in natural rubber, nitrile and butyl.

faqs.q: How do I read Oteco Grant stripper rubber part numbers such as 241302 and 241602?
faqs.a: Each number is one pipe size in one compound. For 3-1/2" drill pipe, 241302 is natural rubber and 241602 is nitrile; for 2-7/8", 241303 is natural rubber and 241603 is nitrile. The butyl rubber for 5-1/2" pipe is 241300.

faqs.q: Which Grant rotating heads do Oteco 2413xx and 2416xx stripper rubbers fit?
faqs.a: They are made to fit Grant 7068 and 8068 rotating heads; this is a fit statement, not an equivalence claim. Grant is a trademark of its owner and Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with that maker. Confirm the head model before ordering.

faqs.q: What drill pipe sizes do Oteco Grant stripper rubbers cover?
faqs.a: Oteco lists Grant 7068 and 8068 stripper rubbers for 2-3/8", 2-7/8", 3-1/8", 3-1/2", 4-1/2", 5" and 5-1/2" drill pipe. Natural rubber and nitrile are listed for each size and butyl is listed for 5-1/2". Pick the size by the pipe in the hole.

faqs.q: Which Oteco stripper rubber do I order for 4-1/2" drill pipe on a Grant rotating head?
faqs.a: Order 241305 in natural rubber or 241605 in nitrile for 4-1/2" drill pipe on a Grant 7068 or 8068 head. The 5" size is 241307 in natural rubber and 241607 in nitrile. Send the head model and pipe OD if you are unsure.

faqs.q: Does Oteco publish a pressure rating for the Grant stripper rubbers?
faqs.a: No pressure rating is listed for these stripper rubbers in the Oteco range data, so we do not quote one. They are sized to the drill pipe, and the head model and pipe size decide the fit. Ask us for the rotating head working pressure from the head maker's documentation.

faqs.q: Which compound do I choose for Oteco Grant stripper rubbers: NR, NBR or butyl?
faqs.a: Natural rubber (NR) suits water-based fluids and nitrile (NBR) suits oil-based fluids. Butyl is listed on the 5-1/2" size only. Every other pipe size is offered in NR and NBR, for example 241308 NR and 241309 NBR for 5-1/2".

faqs.q: What other stripper rubbers can Oteco supply?
faqs.a: Oteco also makes tubing stripper rubbers for Beaumont Iron Works PX-70 and PX-107, Cameron Petromec QD, Guiberson J2, Hillerman Kelley HK, Hinderliter SS, 4-S and 4-1, Hydril RS, Larkin K and SR, Norris Hinderliter 4-1 and Oil Center Tool T-16 stripper heads. For Shaffer heads see [Oteco Shaffer stripper rubbers](/p/oteco-shaffer-rotating-head-stripper-rubbers).

faqs.q: How do I order the right Oteco stripper rubber for a Grant 8068 head?
faqs.a: Give the head model, the drill pipe OD and the drilling fluid. The pipe OD sets the part number and the fluid sets natural rubber or nitrile. Send the details with the markings on the old rubber and we confirm the Oteco number before shipping.

faqs.q: When is a stripper rubber replaced on a Grant rotating head?
faqs.a: A stripper rubber is replaced when it no longer seals around the rotating pipe, typically through wear from rotation and tool joints. It is a recurring consumable in [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts). For annular preventer elements see [Oteco Hydril annular packing units](/p/oteco-hydril-annular-bop-packing-units).

faqs.q: Where are Oteco Grant rotating head stripper rubbers made?
faqs.a: They are moulded by Oteco Inc. in Houston, Texas, USA, and the country of origin is the United States. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Oteco distributor for the Middle East. [contact us](/contact) for the maker's documentation.

faqs.q: Do you stock Oteco stripper rubbers for Grant 7068 and 8068 rotating heads?
faqs.a: We keep Oteco stripper rubbers for Grant rotating heads in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the Oteco part number, or the head model, drill pipe size and compound, and [request a quote](/quote).
